mapper.sql: id, order_no, user_id, product_id, product_code, product_name, product_type, amount_cents, score_amount, gold_coin_amount, vip_type, vip_days, payment_channel, status, expires_at, user_hidden, provider_trade_no, paid_amount_cents, notify_payload_hash, created_at, paid_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM app_payment_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM app_payment_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND user_hidden = 0 AND status != 'CLOSED' AND (status != 'PENDING' OR expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE app_payment_order SET user_hidden = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status != 'PAID' AND user_hidden = 0
UPDATE app_payment_order SET status = 'CLOSED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
UPDATE app_payment_order SET status = 'CLOSED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE app_payment_order SET status = 'PAID', user_hidden = 0, paid_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, provider_trade_no = COALESCE(#{providerTradeNo}, provider_trade_no), paid_amount_cents = COALESCE(#{paidAmountCents}, paid_amount_cents), notify_payload_hash = COALESCE(#{notifyPayloadHash}, notify_payload_hash) WHERE id = #{id} AND status != 'PAID'
